fields.Title: Markdown Editor & Reader Esuyo
fields.ShortDescription: Offline Markdown editor and reader for local folders. Browse every .md file as a tree or flat list, read with syntax highlighting, edit in rich text or raw source, and save straight back to disk. No account, cloud sync, telemetry or ads.
fields.Description:
Esuyo Markdown is a fast, offline Markdown editor and reader for local .md files. Point it at any folder and browse every .md and .markdown file inside, as a flat list or a collapsible folder tree, then read with clean, syntax-highlighted formatting or edit in rich text and raw source, saving straight back to disk.

Everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud sync, no telemetry, no ads, the only network use is optional Google Fonts loading.

Built for docs, notes, wikis and repos:
• Recursive browsing with .gitignore support and a built-in skip list for node_modules, .git and friends
• Flat file list or collapsible folder tree
• Clean reading view with syntax-highlighted code blocks and GFM tables
• Tabs with independent drafts, switch freely, and your open tabs are restored per folder
• Rich-text (WYSIWYG) editing plus a raw Markdown source mode
• New file, Save As and safe delete to the Recycle Bin
• Light and dark themes, customizable body/heading/code fonts and sizes, plus quick zoom
• Keyboard-first: ↑/↓ to move between files, Ctrl+N/S/W for new/save/close, Ctrl+Tab to switch tabs
• Recent folders and settings that persist locally between sessions

Open source and offline by design.

keywords.note: Partner Center DOES have a hidden Keywords field (Store listing > Additional information): up to 7 keywords, 40 chars each, 21 words total. `applied` is exactly what is saved in the en-us draft. In the real listings CSV these map to SearchTerm1..SearchTerm7, not to a field named 'Keywords'. The field is hidden from customers but used for discoverability. Irrelevant keyword stuffing can still hurt ranking.

localizationExperiment.approved: 2026-11-23, top-10 waves; prep now (name checks, translations, CSV, per-market rank tracking)
localizationExperiment.startCondition: Submission 6 publishes, then a 2-4 week en-GB baseline window
localizationExperiment.design: Wave 1 (de, fr, es, pt-BR, ru) receives localized Store listings; Wave 2 (ja, ko, zh-CN, it, nl) stays English as the control. After reading the result, localize the control.
localizationExperiment.primaryMetric: per-market Store search rank for local-language 'markdown editor' queries
localizationExperiment.nameAvailability: Checked and RESERVED in Partner Center on 2026-11-23 with explicit human approval; all 10 appear as 'Reserved for this app'. Reservations expire in 3 months if no submission uses them.
